description:
Quenderin is an AI assistant that runs locally on your Mac. Download a model once, then chat offline without an account or an AI cloud subscription.

• On-device conversations — your model generates replies on your Mac.
• Model library — choose from 13 open models, with download sizes and memory-fit guidance, or search for compatible GGUF models.
• Native Mac workspace — keep separate conversations, search your chats, and use keyboard shortcuts.
• Built-in tools — ask the local agent to calculate, convert units, and work with dates. Optional device tools require permission.
• English, Russian, Korean, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese interfaces.

Internet access is needed for model downloads and online model search. Models are large; download time and response speed depend on your connection, storage, memory, and hardware. Once a model is installed, local chat works offline.

AI-generated responses can be inaccurate or objectionable. Review important information before relying on it.
promotionalText: Private AI chat on your Mac. Download an open model, then talk offline. A native workspace for conversations, model management, and useful local tools.
